description: Compares rubber quotas in the Congo, forced debt in the Putumayo, and Kimberley mine compounds, showing how colonial firms converted resource extraction into control over labor.

period.label: Colonial extraction regimes, c. 1867–1913 CE
period.note: The Kimberley diamond boom begins in the late 1860s; the Congo rubber system and Putumayo investigations belong largely to the late nineteenth and early twentieth centuries. This is a comparative range, not one continuous event.
